build_resnet18_model: build a ResNet18 model with Haiku for image classification with a specified number of classes
build_resnet50_model: build a ResNet50 bottleneck model with Haiku for image classification with v1 or v2 architecture
create_blockv1_module: create a ResNet V1 block module with optional bottleneck and batch normalization configuration
create_blockv2_module: create a ResNet V2 block module with pre-activation residual connections and batch normalization
build_blockgroup_module: build a BlockGroup module containing multiple ResNet V1 or V2 blocks with shared channel configuration
